supersession.reason: The predecessor correctly established the native child identity gap. This successor removes an unsafe implicit coupling between agent_id, task_id and tool_use_id by modeling them as distinct identity domains until an observed join exists.

architecture_delta.role: Immutable/append-only causal binding between durable Frankenstein delegated-work intent and observed native execution-child/task/tool lifecycle evidence. It is not a spawn runtime and not a completion authority.

session_id.semantics: Conversation/session scope; insufficient by itself for child attribution.

generation.semantics: Prevents stale/replayed child results from crossing recovery/restart boundaries.

agent_tool_use_id.unknown_policy: UNKNOWN until the installed runtime emits it for the actual spawn call
agent_tool_use_id.semantics: Native spawn-tool invocation identity, not the child actor identity.

task_id.unknown_policy: ABSENT_OR_UNKNOWN for an ordinary subagent path unless the task system actually participates
task_id.semantics: Task-system identity. MUST NOT be treated as agent_id.

agent_type.semantics: Native child type/name, useful for policy but not sufficient identity.

agent_transcript_path.semantics: Child transcript locator/evidence pointer; content is not automatically canonical truth.

reconcile_evidence_ref.semantics: Evidence that the durable workpackage was reconciled after child execution.

allowed_promotions: WORKPACKAGE_RECORDED -> SPAWN_INVOCATION_OBSERVED only from an exact Agent tool event bound to the package by an observed mechanism
SPAWN_INVOCATION_OBSERVED -> CHILD_STARTED only when a deterministic shared key or observed runtime relationship joins the invocation to agent_id
CHILD_STARTED -> CHILD_STOPPED only for the same agent_id and generation
TASK_CREATED_OPTIONAL/TASK_COMPLETED_OPTIONAL are parallel task-system facts and do not establish child identity by themselves
CHILD_STOPPED -> RESULT_CANDIDATE_RECORDED treats last_assistant_message/transcript as candidate output only
RESULT_CANDIDATE_RECORDED -> RECONCILED requires explicit stern.py reconcile/evidence acceptance at the declared scope
fail_closed_invariants: Never join tool_use_id to agent_id by timestamp proximity, event order, agent_type or narrative similarity.
Never treat task_id as agent_id or require task_id when the task system did not participate.
Never mark a workpackage complete solely because SubagentStop fired or last_assistant_message exists.
Never accept stale generation or ambiguous package/child provenance.
Two concurrent Agent invocations must remain distinct even if they share session_id, agent_type or similar prompts.
If an external effect outcome is unknown inside child work, reconciliation remains UNKNOWN until effect evidence closes it.
Source/docs capability evidence cannot substitute for installed-host lifecycle observation.
integration_points: stern.py handoff: emit/return workpackage_id only; no invented child identity
hook dispatcher/config successor: capture Agent Pre/PostToolUse plus SubagentStart/SubagentStop when the installed runtime proves support
optional TaskCreated/TaskCompleted capture: keep task namespace independent
stern.py reconcile: consume only an unambiguous binding plus declared evidence; do not infer completion from child text
GRID10 coordinator: use binding state for actor/task ownership and recovery rather than session-level heuristics

observed_evidence.donor_live_code: handoff() creates entityos_arbeitspaket/capsule and explicitly does not spawn.
observed_evidence.donor_config: hooks.json registers seven events and lacks dedicated SubagentStart/SubagentStop/TaskCreated/TaskCompleted hooks.
observed_evidence.donor_spec: architekt_governance expects handoff before spawn and reconcile afterwards.
observed_evidence.external_primary: Current Claude Code docs describe Agent as the native spawn tool, agent_id on SubagentStart/SubagentStop, task_id on TaskCreated/TaskCompleted, and tool_use_id plus tool_response on tool hooks; Agent-specific tool_response correlation to agent_id was not established by the reviewed docs.

hypothesis: Most of the Frankenstein-2.0 child harness can reuse native Claude child lifecycle if WorkExecutionBinding/v1 preserves identity-domain separation and only promotes edges proven by installed-runtime evidence.
counterhypothesis: The installed host may lack the documented ABI or may not provide a deterministic invocation-to-child join, requiring a bounded wrapper/transcript correlation primitive instead of direct hook-only binding.

cheapest_high_information_discriminator.name: ONE_HARMLESS_NATIVE_CHILD_CAUSAL_CAPTURE
required_observations: Agent PostToolUse payload including exact tool_response shape
whether any stable shared key directly joins tool_use_id to agent_id
whether TaskCreated/TaskCompleted fires for this ordinary subagent path
cheapest_high_information_discriminator.acceptance: A deterministic non-timing join is observed and replayable; otherwise WorkExecutionBinding retains UNKNOWN and the direct-hook binding hypothesis is falsified for that build.

triggerword4_feed.instruction: Do not freeze a child-harness ABI that aliases package, agent, task and tool identities. First prove the installed native join, then implement the smallest fail-closed WorkExecutionBinding successor.
